casefold.label: Casefold
casefold.function: Normalize the shopper message to lowercase before any alias lookup. This is the single shared start of rewrite.
casefold.implementation: rewrite_for_nlu calls message.casefold() and emits the folded string. Color and material maps are case-insensitive, so every later n-gram runs on this text. An empty fold skips the rest of rewrite.

detail.text: i'm looking for shoes slippers. your new favorite slippers: slip into divine comfort with gemma, a plush mule-style spa slipper with an adjustable hook-and-loop closure across the vamp

color_map.label: Color map
color_map.function: Find color phrases in the folded sentence and map them onto the closed catalog color set (for example navy → blue).
color_map.implementation: A longest-match scan over 1–4 token n-grams reads the committed color alias JSON in parallel with the material map. Jewelry metals (gold, silver, platinum) are not rewritten to yellow or white. Hits still need the optional LLM word-class gate.

material_map.label: Material map
material_map.function: Find material phrases in the same folded sentence and map them onto the closed material set.
material_map.implementation: Same longest-match design as color, with 1–5 token n-grams and the material alias table. A span that hits both maps becomes a combined “color material” rewrite token at merge.

color_verify.label: Color LLM
color_verify.function: Keep a color hit only when both the source phrase and the replacement are color words.
color_verify.implementation: An optional Ollama word-class gate on each color pair. This drops accidental aliases such as easy → brown. Regex mode and a missing NLU client skip the gate and keep the map hits unchanged.

material_verify.label: Material LLM
material_verify.function: Keep a material hit only when both sides of the pair are material words.
material_verify.implementation: The material-side twin of the color gate, run in parallel. Surviving hits are the only replacements merge_rewrite will apply.

merge_rewrite.label: Rewrite
merge_rewrite.function: Apply kept color and material replacements and produce the sentence used by attribute NLU.
merge_rewrite.implementation: Replacements are written back onto the folded string in span order. The original message is stored on the session unchanged. Category walk still reads that original sentence; only attribute extract uses the rewrite.

detail.original: I'm looking for Shoes Slippers. YOUR NEW FAVORITE SLIPPERS: Slip into divine comfort with Gemma, a plush mule-style spa slipper with an adjustable hook-and-loop closure across the vamp
detail.rewritten: i'm looking for shoes slippers. your new favorite slippers: slip into purple brown with gemma, a black gray-style white slipper with an adjustable hook-and-loop closure across the vamp

merge_rewrite.summary: i'm looking for shoes slippers. your new favorite slippers: slip into pu

category_l1.label: Category L1
category_l1.function: Choose Amazon L1 roots that the original message actually supports.
category_l1.implementation: category_tree loads the fold-pruned three-level tree (promo merchandising children omitted) and asks the category LLM over L1 roots. An empty id list stops the walk; no extra LLM round starts.
category_l1.summary: Clothing, Shoes and Jewelry, Shoe, Jewelry & Watch Accessories

category_l2.label: Category L2
category_l2.function: Walk selected L1 children into L2 labels.
category_l2.implementation: Selected L1 nodes concatenate their children; the LLM picks among those children only. category_scope drops L2+ branches that add kids, gender, or age the shopper did not state.

category_l3.label: Category L3
category_l3.function: Walk selected L2 children into L3 labels.
category_l3.implementation: Same child-concat walk as L2. A layer with no children ends the tree. Session category is not committed here; turn_delta only stores the extract.

category_cap.label: Category cap
category_cap.function: When this turn still has more than five category tags, keep the five closest tags that can contain the shopper's item.
category_cap.implementation: Safety net after identity emit. The model must return five tags that fold_category-match the allowed list and cover cited product types. Invalid JSON retries up to three times. After three misses, keep cited tags plus the highest slot_stats.df counts in that pool.

attribute_llm.label: Attributes
attribute_llm.function: Extract typed slots — attribute, value, hardness, and cite spans — from the rewritten sentence.
attribute_llm.implementation: Ollama returns JSON constraints. Each attribute has its own handler (color, material, size, budget, …) for cite-vs-classify and alias policy. Regex mode skips this model and uses classify.py instead.

repair_1.label: Repair 1
repair_1.function: First retry when the attribute JSON is missing or unusable.
repair_1.implementation: hybrid_extract allows three NLU attempts with the same schema. This is attempt 2. A valid payload ends the loop; otherwise repair 2 runs.

repair_2.label: Repair 2
repair_2.function: Second retry of the attribute JSON extract.
repair_2.implementation: Same client and schema as attribute_llm. Still no override keys — intention routing does not live in understand.

repair_3.label: Repair 3
repair_3.function: Last model attempt before regex fallback.
repair_3.implementation: If this call is None or invalid, hybrid_extract falls back to classify.py. Colon-fallback can still parse a last-resort constraint.

disclosure.label: Disclosure
disclosure.function: After category+attribute, void the delta when the utterance disclosed neither.
disclosure.implementation: A local JSON call sees the original sentence plus this turn's category and attribute rows. {"empty": true} clears the extract so turn_delta is None. Invalid JSON retries up to three times; three misses keep the delta (fail-open). Regex mode skips this node.

turn_delta.label: Turn delta
turn_delta.function: Write this turn’s extract onto SessionState.turn_delta and stop. Nothing is committed to the live constraint set here.
turn_delta.implementation: observe in coordinator.py stores source, category, slots, and empty. The intention router’s replace/accumulate writeback is what later upserts slots. There is no turn==1 special case and no evaluator Buying/Browsing label.

override_l1.label: Override L1
override_l1.function: Decide whether this utterance discards every committed category and every committed attribute.
override_l1.implementation: A local JSON call returns {"full": true|false}. Skipped when no committed prior intent exists. True clears all typed constraints then apply_delta and opens the conversion gate.

override_l2.label: Override L2
override_l2.function: If not a full reset, decide whether some committed preferences are being replaced rather than added.
override_l2.implementation: A second JSON call returns {"override": true|false}. True drops only the attribute names present on this turn’s delta, then apply_delta, and opens the conversion gate. Adding alternatives is false and accumulates.

replace_delta.label: Replace
replace_delta.function: Clear all typed constraints, then apply this turn’s delta (L1).
replace_delta.implementation: clear_typed then apply_delta. Opens the conversion gate and clears last_ranked. Skipped on L2 and accumulate.

drop_slots.label: Drop slots
drop_slots.function: Drop committed fields that appear in this turn’s delta (L2).
drop_slots.implementation: drop_typed uses delta attribute names, then apply_delta writes the new values. Opens the conversion gate. Skipped on L1 and accumulate.

probe_override.label: Probe once
probe_override.function: Build the hard exact ASIN pool once, on the replaced state.
probe_override.implementation: exact_pool_for_state intersects hard signatures (OR inside an attribute, AND across groups), then applies hard budget / LWH / weight filters. Soft slots never enter this set. Override does not probe a before-count.

intention_override.label: Override label
intention_override.function: Set intention=override and skip buying versus browsing.
intention_override.implementation: route_llm is skipped. Retrieve still scores this exact set with buying-like weights and a 150-hit cap. Failsafe may still open the conversion gate at turn 4.

probe_before.label: Probe before
probe_before.function: Exact pool on the committed state before this turn’s delta is applied.
probe_before.implementation: The before count is stored as candidate_count_before_delta. Together with the after count it forms the ratio classify_route sees. Skipped on override.

apply_delta.label: Accumulate
apply_delta.function: Upsert this turn’s slots onto the committed session state.
apply_delta.implementation: apply_delta writes hard and soft typed slots. Same-key updates keep the later hardness. This is the only writeback on the non-override path.

probe_after.label: Probe after
probe_after.function: Exact pool after accumulate — the set retrieve will score if nonempty.
probe_after.implementation: None is not zero: a missing pool and an empty intersection both send retrieve down hybrid recovery. The after count becomes candidate_count.

route_llm.label: Route LLM
route_llm.function: Label the turn buying or browsing from dialogue plus pool ratio.
route_llm.implementation: classify_route is a second Qwen JSON call. It receives pool_before, pool_after, and their ratio. There is no regex intention fallback. The call is skipped after override.

buying.label: Buying
buying.function: Outcome node: intention=buying, tighter structured weights, 150-hit cap.
buying.implementation: routing_for('buying') sets lexical 0.4 / required 6.0 / category 4.0 and BUYING_LIMIT=150. Mutually exclusive with browsing.

browsing.label: Browsing
browsing.function: Outcome node: intention=browsing, lexical-heavier weights, 500-hit cap.
browsing.implementation: routing_for('browsing') sets lexical 1.6 / required 2.5 and BROWSING_LIMIT=500 so soft exploration stays wider.

failsafe.label: Failsafe
failsafe.function: Open the conversion gate at turn 4 if a missed override left it closed.
failsafe.implementation: apply_override_failsafe sets gate_open when turn >= 4 and the gate is still closed. It does not rewrite intention, bump intent_version, or set override_seen. Both router branches end here.

detail.why: opens the conversion gate at turn 4 if it is still closed

failsafe.summary: opens the conversion gate at turn 4 if it is still closed

slot_groups.label: Slot groups
slot_groups.function: Turn committed typed slots into required groups, preferred groups, and an optional budget interval.
slot_groups.implementation: from_slots.required_and_budget reads hard slots (OR inside an attribute, AND across). Soft slots become preferred_groups and never prune. Hard budget drops missing-price items; soft budget only withholds a bonus. Category is handled separately.

rewrite_query.label: Query
rewrite_query.function: Build the BM25 query from the current category plus committed search values.
rewrite_query.implementation: rewrite_query joins category and slot search terms. The raw message is fallback only when that string is empty — replaying it after slots exist would restore negated or superseded words.

output.query: shoe purple brown black gray white clothing shoe jewelry shoe jewelry watch accessories

routing.label: Routing
routing.function: Pick score weights and hit caps from the router-labeled intention.
routing.implementation: routing_for(intention) returns TrackRouting. Buying and override share the 150 cap; browsing uses 500. Hard intersection already happened in the router; this node only chooses how to score.

lexical_in_pool.label: Lexical ∩ pool
lexical_in_pool.function: BM25 scores restricted to ASINs already in the router exact set.
lexical_in_pool.implementation: lexical_scores(query, candidate_limit) then keep only keys in exact. Taken only when that set is nonempty. This is a tie-break inside the pool, not a new recall.

input.query: shoe purple brown black gray white clothing shoe jewelry shoe jewelry watch accessories

score_exact.label: Score exact
score_exact.function: Structured-score every exact-pool ASIN with the routing weights.
score_exact.implementation: score_candidates fuses lexical, required coverage, category, budget, dimensions, soft text, and weak profile tags. Missing required slots are penalized; preferred slots never drop a candidate.

hybrid_search.label: Hybrid search
hybrid_search.function: Recover candidates with BM25 ∪ catalog signatures when the exact pool is empty, missing, or smaller than 150.
hybrid_search.implementation: retriever.search(..., hard_required=False) so an over-pruned intersection does not yield an empty slate. A small exact pool keeps hard hits first and fills to 300 (browsing 500); a pool of 150+ skips this node. Excluded ASINs from earlier slates are dropped.

detail.why: exact pool already meets candidate floor

hybrid_search.summary: exact pool already meets candidate floor

cap_hits.label: Cap hits
cap_hits.function: Truncate the scored list to the routing limit. Merge of both recall paths.
cap_hits.implementation: hits[:routing.limit] when exact already has 150+; otherwise exact hits plus hybrid fill to 300/500, hard segment first. Official respond still uses planner/gate, not this full library.

qwen_rerank.label: Qwen rerank
qwen_rerank.function: Optional local cross-encoder that reorders the retrieved head by semantic shopping fit.
qwen_rerank.implementation: QwenSemanticReranker scores the first 50 hits with a structured query/product pair. Buying fuses at 0.35, browsing at 0.55. Missing weights or AGENT_RERANKER_LOCAL_FILES_ONLY skips safely to belief.

belief_hits.label: Belief
belief_hits.function: Deterministic ranking weights from retrieval scores when the semantic head is off.
belief_hits.implementation: belief_from_hits uses exp((s − max) / 0.12). These are ranking beliefs, not calibrated purchase probabilities.

normalize.label: Normalize
normalize.function: Turn positive weights into RankedCandidate probabilities the planner can read.
normalize.implementation: normalize_probabilities sorts by weight and divides by the total. The planner uses only parent_asin order and probability.

answer_signature.label: Answers
answer_signature.function: Cache how each remaining ASIN would answer a structured question.
answer_signature.implementation: make_answer_signature memoizes retriever.predict_reply(asin, attribute, disclosed). Empty values become the NO_ADDITIONAL sentinel so the planner can partition the residual.

eligible_questions.label: Questions
eligible_questions.function: List ask_attribute values that can still split the belief, plus ask-nothing.
eligible_questions.implementation: eligible_questions walks QUESTION_ATTRIBUTES. Turn 10 returns only None. Already-asked or already-hard typed attributes are skipped; other may repeat because it reveals the next undisclosed pair.

planner.label: Planner
planner.function: Jointly choose which question to ask and how many products to expose.
planner.implementation: ScoreAwarePlanner searches ask × k ∈ [0, top_k]. Immediate hit utility is 0.50 + 0.30/rank + 0.02×(11−turn), plus future_value of reply partitions. Turn 10 and empty disclosure are a full slate and no question. Empty pools ask other (or nothing on turn 10).

detail.reason: dynamic slate: two-observation expected utility, k=3

output.reason: dynamic slate: two-observation expected utility, k=3

sequential_gate.label: Slate gate
sequential_gate.function: After planning, decide whether to show the planned slate or only rank-1.
sequential_gate.implementation: apply_sequential_gate keeps slate[:1] when the gate is open, it is not turn 10, the planned slate is wider than one, and either an informative question remains or leftover candidates still fit one-per-turn plus the final Top-10. Empty disclosure keeps the planned Top-K.

gate_rank1.label: Rank-1
gate_rank1.function: Expose only the top planned ASIN this turn.
gate_rank1.implementation: Rank-1 can convert now; lower ranks usually wait for the answer and free no-hit feedback. This branch is skipped when the gate does not truncate.

detail.why: gate did not truncate the planned slate

gate_rank1.summary: gate did not truncate the planned slate

keep_planned.label: Keep slate
keep_planned.function: Keep the planner’s wider recommendation list.
keep_planned.implementation: Taken on turn 10, on empty disclosure, when the gate is closed, when there is no useful question and too many leftovers to probe one-by-one, or when the planned slate is already a singleton.

persist_turn.label: Persist
persist_turn.function: Write this turn’s slate and question into session memory for the next turn.
persist_turn.implementation: persist_turn sets reply_value_lookup from predicted replies (semicolon restore) and record_action writes last_slate, last_ask, asked, and shown_asins. Next-turn miss_feedback reads last_slate.

build_response.label: Respond
build_response.function: Assemble the official respond dict: message, ask_attribute, recommendations, usage.
build_response.implementation: build_response formats a short English message from slate length plus explain_question(ask_attribute). recommendations are {parent_asin} objects only. usage carries this turn’s router tokens.

input.reason: dynamic slate: two-observation expected utility, k=3

output.message: I narrowed this to 3 high-confidence options. Which product feature matters most to you?

category_l2.label: Category L2
category_l2.function: Walk selected L1 children into L2 labels.
category_l2.implementation: Selected L1 nodes concatenate their children; the LLM picks among those children only. category_scope drops L2+ branches that add kids, gender, or age the shopper did not state.

category_l3.label: Category L3
category_l3.function: Walk selected L2 children into L3 labels.

category_cap.label: Category cap

attribute_llm.label: Attributes

attribute_llm.implementation: Ollama returns JSON constraints. Each attribute has its own handler (color, material, size, budget, …) for cite-vs-classify and alias policy. Regex mode skips this model and uses classify.py instead.

repair_1.label: Repair 1
repair_1.function: First retry when the attribute JSON is missing or unusable.
repair_1.implementation: hybrid_extract allows three NLU attempts with the same schema. This is attempt 2. A valid payload ends the loop; otherwise repair 2 runs.

repair_2.label: Repair 2
repair_2.function: Second retry of the attribute JSON extract.
repair_2.implementation: Same client and schema as attribute_llm. Still no override keys — intention routing does not live in understand.

repair_3.label: Repair 3
repair_3.function: Last model attempt before regex fallback.
repair_3.implementation: If this call is None or invalid, hybrid_extract falls back to classify.py. Colon-fallback can still parse a last-resort constraint.

disclosure.label: Disclosure
disclosure.function: After category+attribute, void the delta when the utterance disclosed neither.
disclosure.implementation: A local JSON call sees the original sentence plus this turn's category and attribute rows. {"empty": true} clears the extract so turn_delta is None. Invalid JSON retries up to three times; three misses keep the delta (fail-open). Regex mode skips this node.

turn_delta.label: Turn delta
turn_delta.function: Write this turn’s extract onto SessionState.turn_delta and stop. Nothing is committed to the live constraint set here.
turn_delta.implementation: observe in coordinator.py stores source, category, slots, and empty. The intention router’s replace/accumulate writeback is what later upserts slots. There is no turn==1 special case and no evaluator Buying/Browsing label.

override_l1.label: Override L1
override_l1.function: Decide whether this utterance discards every committed category and every committed attribute.
override_l1.implementation: A local JSON call returns {"full": true|false}. Skipped when no committed prior intent exists. True clears all typed constraints then apply_delta and opens the conversion gate.

override_l2.label: Override L2
override_l2.function: If not a full reset, decide whether some committed preferences are being replaced rather than added.
override_l2.implementation: A second JSON call returns {"override": true|false}. True drops only the attribute names present on this turn’s delta, then apply_delta, and opens the conversion gate. Adding alternatives is false and accumulates.

replace_delta.label: Replace
replace_delta.function: Clear all typed constraints, then apply this turn’s delta (L1).
replace_delta.implementation: clear_typed then apply_delta. Opens the conversion gate and clears last_ranked. Skipped on L2 and accumulate.

drop_slots.label: Drop slots
drop_slots.function: Drop committed fields that appear in this turn’s delta (L2).
drop_slots.implementation: drop_typed uses delta attribute names, then apply_delta writes the new values. Opens the conversion gate. Skipped on L1 and accumulate.

probe_override.label: Probe once
probe_override.function: Build the hard exact ASIN pool once, on the replaced state.
probe_override.implementation: exact_pool_for_state intersects hard signatures (OR inside an attribute, AND across groups), then applies hard budget / LWH / weight filters. Soft slots never enter this set. Override does not probe a before-count.

intention_override.label: Override label
intention_override.function: Set intention=override and skip buying versus browsing.
intention_override.implementation: route_llm is skipped. Retrieve still scores this exact set with buying-like weights and a 150-hit cap. Failsafe may still open the conversion gate at turn 4.

probe_before.label: Probe before
probe_before.function: Exact pool on the committed state before this turn’s delta is applied.
probe_before.implementation: The before count is stored as candidate_count_before_delta. Together with the after count it forms the ratio classify_route sees. Skipped on override.

cap_hits.function: Truncate the scored list to the routing limit. Merge of both recall paths.
cap_hits.implementation: hits[:routing.limit] when exact already has 150+; otherwise exact hits plus hybrid fill to 300/500, hard segment first. Official respond still uses planner/gate, not this full library.

qwen_rerank.label: Qwen rerank
qwen_rerank.function: Optional local cross-encoder that reorders the retrieved head by semantic shopping fit.
qwen_rerank.implementation: QwenSemanticReranker scores the first 50 hits with a structured query/product pair. Buying fuses at 0.35, browsing at 0.55. Missing weights or AGENT_RERANKER_LOCAL_FILES_ONLY skips safely to belief.

belief_hits.label: Belief
belief_hits.function: Deterministic ranking weights from retrieval scores when the semantic head is off.
belief_hits.implementation: belief_from_hits uses exp((s − max) / 0.12). These are ranking beliefs, not calibrated purchase probabilities.

normalize.label: Normalize
normalize.function: Turn positive weights into RankedCandidate probabilities the planner can read.
normalize.implementation: normalize_probabilities sorts by weight and divides by the total. The planner uses only parent_asin order and probability.

answer_signature.label: Answers
answer_signature.function: Cache how each remaining ASIN would answer a structured question.
answer_signature.implementation: make_answer_signature memoizes retriever.predict_reply(asin, attribute, disclosed). Empty values become the NO_ADDITIONAL sentinel so the planner can partition the residual.

eligible_questions.label: Questions
eligible_questions.function: List ask_attribute values that can still split the belief, plus ask-nothing.
eligible_questions.implementation: eligible_questions walks QUESTION_ATTRIBUTES. Turn 10 returns only None. Already-asked or already-hard typed attributes are skipped; other may repeat because it reveals the next undisclosed pair.

planner.label: Planner
planner.function: Jointly choose which question to ask and how many products to expose.
planner.implementation: ScoreAwarePlanner searches ask × k ∈ [0, top_k]. Immediate hit utility is 0.50 + 0.30/rank + 0.02×(11−turn), plus future_value of reply partitions. Turn 10 and empty disclosure are a full slate and no question. Empty pools ask other (or nothing on turn 10).

sequential_gate.label: Slate gate
sequential_gate.function: After planning, decide whether to show the planned slate or only rank-1.
sequential_gate.implementation: apply_sequential_gate keeps slate[:1] when the gate is open, it is not turn 10, the planned slate is wider than one, and either an informative question remains or leftover candidates still fit one-per-turn plus the final Top-10. Empty disclosure keeps the planned Top-K.

gate_rank1.label: Rank-1
gate_rank1.function: Expose only the top planned ASIN this turn.
gate_rank1.implementation: Rank-1 can convert now; lower ranks usually wait for the answer and free no-hit feedback. This branch is skipped when the gate does not truncate.

keep_planned.label: Keep slate
keep_planned.function: Keep the planner’s wider recommendation list.
keep_planned.implementation: Taken on turn 10, on empty disclosure, when the gate is closed, when there is no useful question and too many leftovers to probe one-by-one, or when the planned slate is already a singleton.

persist_turn.label: Persist
persist_turn.function: Write this turn’s slate and question into session memory for the next turn.
persist_turn.implementation: persist_turn sets reply_value_lookup from predicted replies (semicolon restore) and record_action writes last_slate, last_ask, asked, and shown_asins. Next-turn miss_feedback reads last_slate.

build_response.label: Respond
build_response.function: Assemble the official respond dict: message, ask_attribute, recommendations, usage.
build_response.implementation: build_response formats a short English message from slate length plus explain_question(ask_attribute). recommendations are {parent_asin} objects only. usage carries this turn’s router tokens.

stage_blurbs.understand: Observe only. Rewrite, walk the category tree, and extract typed slots into turn_delta. Constraints are committed later by the router.
stage_blurbs.router: Override versus accumulate, probe the hard exact pool, then label buying, browsing, or override. Unused branches stay on the graph.
stage_blurbs.retrieve: Score a nonempty exact pool, or hybrid-recover when it is empty. Then optional Qwen rerank or deterministic belief, then normalize.
stage_blurbs.decide: Search question × slate size, apply the sequential gate, persist memory, and return the official respond dict.
